problem: Live mass canary produced semantically duplicate discovery proposals with distinct fingerprints because the fingerprint hashes worker-authored target, problem, and acceptance wording without a pre-pin semantic-equivalence or alias stage.
acceptance: Replay of the observed GEN2 scope-repair pair resolves to one semantic family before a second durable proposal pin is created.
Materially distinct owner, scope, privacy, or output semantics remain separate and are not falsely merged.
Duplicate losers record duplicate-of or collision evidence without overwriting the winner.
The equivalence decision is reproducible and auditable from durable inputs rather than hidden model state.
No queue, Current, Human Accepted, Served, or production authority is promoted.
title: Close semantic gap before discovery fingerprint pinning
mission: Add and falsify an auditable pre-pin semantic-equivalence layer for discovery proposals so materially equivalent worker discoveries converge before create-if-absent fingerprint pinning, while preserving separation for materially distinct owner/scope/privacy/output targets. Use the observed GEN2 scope-contract duplicate pair as a regression fixture and retain the existing exact-fingerprint atomic pin as the final ownership primitive.

incident_repair.reason: The live canary produced two distinct durable fingerprints for materially equivalent GEN2 scope-contract repair discoveries within the same minute.

regression_prevention.reason: Exact-fingerprint create-if-absent prevents byte-identical ownership races but cannot prevent semantically equivalent proposal fan-out caused by worker-authored wording variance.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Converging equivalent discoveries before pinning reduces duplicate proposal review and reconciliation work as identical /wc launches scale.

fail_if: the known GEN2 equivalent pair can still create two independent semantic-family pins
materially distinct owner/scope/privacy/output proposals are incorrectly merged
semantic equivalence depends on opaque model memory or non-replayable hidden state
the new layer weakens the existing create-if-absent ownership collision guarantee
